game_concept: A card battler set in Coastal Port – Shipyard Slip, a shipyard building boats: the fisher must handle pirate raiders while practicing conditionals (if / elif / else). Core idea – Nested Maze: Pick routes through nested if statements that branch inside branches.
theme: Coastal Port – Shipyard Slip: a shipyard building boats
core_gameplay_loop: In Shipyard Slip, repeat each round: Pick routes through nested if statements that branch inside branches. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the route_score value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 7 consecutive correct decisions about route_score to power up the fisher and open the dock crane.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 3 – Conditionals (if / elif / else) | Level 5 (applied tier): Nested Maze
assets_style: pixel-art harbor town: deep blue sea, wooden docks, orange-roofed buildings, sailing ships; flat Kenney-style sprites; sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Nested Maze' (Week 3 slot 6), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Shipyard Slip'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Coastal Port
region.mood: sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how route_score changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against pirate raiders in Shipyard Slip.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 7.
